description: This is a PHP class definition for the Tax total module within the OpenCart extension system, specifically in the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Model.Extension.Opencart.Total. It contains a method to calculate and add tax totals to an order.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Defines a class for calculating tax totals within the OpenCart extension system, extending the base engine Model class.

methods.name: getTotal
